notes.title: Update 0.46a - What's New?
notes.content:
Hey All!

Sorry for the delay getting this latest update out to you but hopefully I can become more frequent with my updates going forward. Having started a new job with a daily commute, it took some getting used to.

So what can you expect in this update? 
[list]
[*] Updated to the latest version of Unity.
[*] There is a new graveyards tile associated with each location, it will grow in size as the game progresses and more people die at these locations.
[*] Another attempt at fixes the armies getting stuck. I rewrote a lot of code and hope this resolves the issue.
[*] Fixed a rare but potential crash when armies meet while mid siege.
[*] Fixed various other minor issues to do with UI alignment.
[/list]

I hope to release another update within the next week which allows users to click the graveyards and show a simple UI detailing all who are buried there. 

Now you may ask why I am adding in Graveyard tiles, well with Halloween approaching I thought it would be nice and festive. I also like the idea of exploring grave robbing in future and the possibility of royal burials at certain tiles, where you can run actions against in hope of buried treasure. This update is the first step towards grave robbing / tomb exploring. 

Thanks again to all those who have purchased the game! :)

notes.title: Next Update - A little bit of history! :)
notes.content:
Hey All!

First of all, thanks to everyone who has been reporting the issues and playing Tales of a Spymaster. I am happy to help deal with any issues asap :)

So I have a new update going live tomorrow which will have a number of very important bug fixes, but I have also added a new feature which I am going to tell you about now. 

When armies meet in battle and one dies, there is nothing to remember them by, I want to change this a little. First of all, there will now be skeletons added to the map where an army has fallen.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34238558/a56e1e171d24adfeba41eb57bbbd86aff1a570c0.png[/img]

And to add to this, they can be clicked and you can learn a little about the combat that took place here. The kingdoms involved, the total losses, what turn it was on and who was victorious. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34238558/6c92f294d92af6abc5219cc2ea4544da210c775c.png[/img]

The world itself is a bit dull and lifeless at times, so in time I hope to add a bit more life and history to it through updates like this.  In the following update, I shall also add this logic to armies who fail in capturing a location. You shall start to see fortresses really show their defensive quality then! :)

I shall release this update tomorrow hopefully and as always, if you have idea about things, please do let me know! :)

notes.title: Did you know? Some tips on things in the game :)
notes.content:
Hey All!

So this is the first of several posts over the coming week or 2 sharing some less obvious features in Tales of a Spymaster. 

[h1]Diplomacy[/h1]

When you open the diplomacy UI, did you know that the coat of arms are clickable? Well they are! You can advise your King/Queen to go to war, advise peace or even an alliance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34238558/6acc8bfb469653dea0969b41f1e70ba404accfe4.png[/img]


[h1]Minimap[/h1]
Some of you have found the world slow to navigate across, but did you know the minimap is clickable? Click anywhere that is not black on the minimap and the camera shall be moved to there instantly! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34238558/c9cbc62c8e43825a951658d13d81de07efc942a5.png[/img]

[h1]Hostages[/h1]
So you have gone all Game of Thrones and decided to take some hostages, now what? Did you know there is a hostage UI that become available in the Plot screen? On the screen, there is ropes in the bottom right. They are a button that becomes clickable when you have a hostage! You can release, ransom and execute them here. It also shows you where the hostage is currently located, should you ever lose control of the location.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34238558/bd2fce770f4aa79273d05b4dae93da778d3f9fd1.png[/img]

Once I fix the bugs with the population, I will do a post giving an overview of how the population works within Tales of a Spymaster as there is a lot going on under the hood.
